meta.title: No Gym Club
meta.description: The street is my gym. Adaptive training guided by sport science.

landing.manifesto: Discipline over motivation. Action over comfort. Brutal, silent progress.
landing.anywhereDesc: Parks, stairs, rusty bars. No subscriptions needed, just gravity and will.
landing.brutalWorkoutsDesc: Programs designed to break plateaus using advanced calisthenics.
landing.noExcusesDesc: Cold, heat, and rain are just external variables. Your discipline is the only constant.
landing.footerDesc: We operate under the radar. We train where others just walk. We don't seek applause, we seek results.

messages: The street is your gym. No excuses today.
Discipline over motivation. Action over comfort.
Quiet, brutal progress. That is how we train.
Parks, stairs and rusty bars. That is all you need.
Just gravity and willpower. The rest is noise.
Founded on asphalt. Built to last.
We operate under the radar. Results speak.
Your first session starts with one decision: show up.
You do not need applause. You need consistency.
Twelve quiet weeks will change everything.
Consistency is not negotiated. It is practiced.
It starts today. Not tomorrow, not Monday: today.
Every set ahead is built for your level.
Tuning every set to your level and your gear.
Picking exercises for the equipment you have.
Building weeks that adapt as you progress.
Cold and rain are external variables. Your discipline is the constant.
No gym, no excuses, no shortcuts.
We are not here for comfort. We are here for strength.
Your body adapts. Your mind decides.
Rest is training too. Consistency carries weight.
One session at a time. One day at a time.
Progress makes no noise. It stacks up.
You are one workout away from starting different.

progress.title: Progress
progress.reassessmentPrompt: It's been {days} days since your last assessment. Want to retake it to measure your progress?
progress.noData: No assessment data yet. Take your first physical test to start tracking progress.

session.completeMessage: Go back to the dashboard to log your RPE.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.hint: We need these parameters to calibrate your initial intensity and training volume.
profile.displayNameHint: Optional. We use it to greet you.
profile.days: Choose how many days a week you can train
profile.focusHint: Pick up to 3 areas or skills (optional).
profile.focusNotes: Anything else you want to tell us
profile.focusNotesPlaceholder: E.g.: I want my first strict pull-up

equipment.title: Available equipment
equipment.hint: Select all the equipment you have access to.

health.title: Health & limitations
health.hint: Select areas with pain or injuries. You can leave all unselected.
health.notesPlaceholder: Tell us more about your limitations...

cardio.title: Cardio
cardio.hint: Do you want to include cardio in your program?

parq.title: Safety Screening (PAR-Q)
parq.description: Answer honestly. If you answer YES to any question, we recommend consulting a doctor before continuing.
parq.q1: Have you ever been diagnosed with a heart condition?
parq.q2: Do you feel chest pain during exercise?
parq.q3: Have you had dizziness or loss of consciousness in the last month?
parq.q4: Do you have a joint or muscle injury that could worsen with exercise?
parq.q5: Do you have uncontrolled high blood pressure?
parq.q6: Has a doctor told you to avoid physical exercise?
parq.q7: Is there any other reason you should consult a doctor before starting?
parq.blocked: PAR-Q not cleared. Please consult a doctor before continuing with the training program.

test.title: Physical tests
test.hint: Five short tests to calibrate your starting point. You can use "I can't do it" at any step.
test.pushupHint: Choose the hardest variation you can do and note how many consecutive reps you complete.
test.sitHint: Sit down and stand up from a chair as many times as you can in 30 seconds.
test.plankHint: Hold the plank as long as possible. Choose the variation you can hold.
test.hangHint: Hang from the bar with straight arms for as long as you can.
test.pullupHint: Do as many consecutive pull-ups as you can.
test.walkHint: How long can you walk without stopping?

settings.title: Settings
settings.photoHint: JPG or PNG, up to 1 MB.
settings.nameError: The name can't be longer than 40 characters.
settings.imageError: Choose an image up to 1 MB.
settings.communityHint: Enable, edit or disable your public profile and choose what is shown.

community.title: Community
community.inviteBody: Enable your public profile to see people training near you. Only your comuna and an approximate distance are shared, never your exact location.
community.editBody: Update what you share with the community. You can disable your public profile at any time.
community.privacyNote: We never show coordinates or a map. The public profile is for adults 18 and over.
community.consent: I understand what is shared and I want to appear in Near you.
community.locationDenied: We could not get your location. You can enable your profile with just your comuna, but you will not appear in distances.
community.bioPlaceholder: Tell the community how you train.
community.minAgeError: The community is for people 18 and over
community.nearbySubtitle: Public profiles within the chosen distance. No map and no coordinates.
community.noResults: No public profiles in this radius. Try a wider radius.
community.blockConfirm: Block {name}? You will no longer see each other in the community.
community.reportError: We could not send the report. Please try again.
